fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Runs you down a target up to 6 tiles away and hamstrings it for 13 damage, leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Nip at the Heels
fusions.desc: Nips the target for 8 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Whistle Up a Heeler
fusions.desc: Whistles up a hound that fights beside you for 15 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds, each bite with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Lope
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
